summary: Scintilla, a port of the 1981 Elka Synthex to the FM-1, built on the Dinghy platform and matched sample by sample against a browser version of the synth.
features: Two oscillators per voice with sync, ring and cross mod; five-mode filter
Two layers with split and double; poly, mono and unison
All 80 factory patches, incl. the Laser Harp 'Ring mod.'
USB and DIN MIDI, USB audio; velocity and aftertouch from the keys
Chorus and reverb; no delay yet
Does not read other firmwares' projects; keeps only its settings

headings: what it costs on the fm-1
